data.text: My family’s fished this lake for generations, and I’d like our village to keep making a living from it. With 100 tons now, we can each catch 10 tons a month, leave 50 to reproduce, and start next month back at 100. That’s $10,000 each every month without shrinking the stock. I propose we all agree to that limit and check the reported catches together each month. John, would you be willing to join that agreement?
